notes.title: Demo update v0.5
notes.content:
First demo update is out ! Here's the changelog:

Update v0.5

Added:

 Little Spiders are now crawling around the environment.
 The Scythe can now shoot white skulls when out of runes. Dealing way less damages but can still be used as last resort and for shootable switches.
 Green skulls now emit light.
 Shootable switches now uses different graphic, more visible and animated.


Changed:

 Automap background is now darker.
 Switching weapon is now way faster.
 Catacombs elevator can no longer be lowered nor raised more than needed.
 Less enemies in the first part of the forest.
 Hell Heads now have limited projectile attack range.
 Gargoyles, Hell Heads & Jaguar Ladies projectiles deals a little bit less damage.


Fixed:

 Wulkshtat Overseer no longer go completely invisible.
 Shadow Helper no longer freeze during fights.
 Jaguar Ladies can no longer suicide down pits.
